resources.description: Live universal sky snapshot, no inputs: geocentric ecliptic longitudes for 13 bodies (Sun through Pluto, Chiron, lunar nodes) with zodiac sign/degree and 64-gate wheel placements, current moon phase and illumination, active retrogrades, and a 30-day almanac of upcoming stations and lunations. JPL-validated ephemeris. JSON. $0.01 USDC via x402, or API key.
